vendoredComponents.name: PIZZA ARROW, RPS, SWINGBY original endless games
vendoredComponents.scope: Three complete original game scripts copied byte-for-byte. Preserve original slow-motion pizza sector cuts and expanding arrow counts; coupled four-lane/three-gesture RPS, multiplier and freeze; SWINGBY distance-from-origin score, gravity, collision damage and recovery. Zero finite levels. Existing shared engine/audio/license sources remain authoritative; no new runtime dependencies.

sharedRuntimeChange: Extend the single shared Canvas2D theme whitelist from simple to simple/dark; original dark theme requires no Pixi. Retain capture, rewind and minifier exclusions. Rebuild with existing deterministic prepare.py; refresh shared transform-map.
